scenario: 今天个性化赛道的主线是先把数据和评测查清楚，再谈模型。一篇核对了推荐 Hugging Face 资源的公开基准，发现知识图谱和物品编号错位，现成的文字信息也没人用；另一篇用快手的随机曝光数据，量出品类报表被推荐策略带偏了多少。模型方面，LMStaR 微调文本 embedding 模型给每个用户挑推荐理由，DualEvolve 让 agent 同时改进推荐模型和自己做实验的流程。

papers.title: Auditing a Model-Hub Benchmark: Data Quality, Training Budgets, and Side Information in HuggingBench
papers.abstract: Benchmarks built from model hubs combine interaction data, knowledge graphs (KGs) and resource documentation, but valid files do not ensure that these artifacts describe the same objects. Treating the release as a data product, we audit HuggingBench (SIGIR 2025), a benchmark for recommending Hugging Face resources, through data validation, a replication of its eleven recommendation methods and controlled experiments with three training seeds. In three of its four external KGs, the files pass key and range checks but violate the item-entity identity constraint on which KG recommenders rely. Correcting this join improves every KG-based method in every seed, by up to 73% in mean Recall@10, and consistently reverses ten of 27 comparisons between KG configurations. The protocol matters as well: the 100-epoch budget ends before early stopping in seven to eight of 29 validation-selected settings, and 21 of 23 such setting-seed pairs improve with a longer budget. The released item text, which no reported method uses, is the strongest signal: closed-form linear models with text and the item graph exceed the best reported Recall@10 by 18% while fitting in minutes on a CPU. Checks of other recommendation releases show that individually valid releases of one dataset can use incompatible identifiers. We release corrected files, mappings, validators and logs, and derive practices for preserving identity and provenance across the artifacts of benchmarks and model lakes.
papers.summary: 做推荐评测的人值得读，因为它查出的问题不在模型，而在数据文件之间的对应关系。推荐 Hugging Face 模型和数据集的公开基准 HuggingBench 里，四份描述物品的知识图谱有三份把物品编号对错了，基于知识图谱的推荐模型一直把别的物品的信息当成这个物品的。这些文件能通过常规的主键和取值范围检查，只有按内容去对才发现错位。改正后，所有基于知识图谱的方法都变好，平均召回率最多提高 73%。基准还带着每个物品的文字介绍，却没有已报告的方法用过；用上这些文字的线性模型在 CPU 上几分钟训完，召回率比已报告的最好结果高 17%。

papers.title: When Category Means Move: A Paired-Support Audit of Recommendation Logs with Random Insertions
papers.authors: Yu Zhang, Zhihan Wang, Yuhang Lu, Shuai Li
papers.abstract: Content-category dashboards summarize production recommendation logs, although the serving policy selects the users, items, and contexts behind each mean. Using KuaiRand random-insertion impressions, we audit these summaries on the same 12,472 users and 5,486 videos in both logs. Standard means have absolute/centered mean absolute error (MAE) 0.1935/0.0491 and rank correlation 0.7833. User demeaning plus a random grand-mean anchor reduces absolute MAE by 80.0%, but centered MAE by only 21.0%, without reliably improving rank. A complete-support ledger allocates weighted squared error mainly to within-video residual (72.41%) and video mix (23.90%), with 3.65% from random support. In a frozen later test, early category calibration reaches MAE 0.0251 versus 0.0531 for scalar calibration; their direct difference is -0.0280 [-0.0296, -0.0172]. Decision evidence is cutoff-specific: the nominal top-10 regret change for row-weighted demeaning versus naive is -0.0062 [-0.0084, -0.0003], while top-5 and top-20 intervals include zero. The six-contrast family-wise top-10 interval [-0.0136, 0.0013] includes zero. An outcome-free disjoint randomized-reference split also leaves all six nominal contrasts covering zero. A known-truth stress test shows incomplete improvement under a mean-additive positive control and failure under item mix and weak overlap. All decompositions are descriptive and each result is conditional on its overlap cohort. KuaiRand intervals quantify user-cluster variation conditional on the realized catalog and calendar; we claim neither intrinsic category effects nor a universally valid correction.
papers.summary: 很多团队用推荐日志里各品类的平均观看完成度决定扶持哪类内容，这篇论文量出了这张报表被推荐策略带偏了多少。作者用快手公开数据 KuaiRand，它会在推荐列表里随机换进一条视频，这些曝光不经过策略挑选，可以当参照。在同一批用户和视频上比较，正常日志里各品类的均值整体偏高很多，品类之间的排序却差得不多。先扣掉每个用户自己的平均水平，再对齐到随机曝光的总均值，各品类和参照的平均差距减少了 80%。可要是把两边的整体水平先拉平，只比每个品类高于或低于平均多少，差距只缩小了 21%，排序也没有可靠变好。

papers.title: Learning to Rank Explanations for Recommendation with Language Models
papers.abstract: Recommender systems are ubiquitous on the Web, making understandable explanations essential for users. Although large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate natural-language justifications, evaluating their factual grounding and personalized relevance remains challenging. Statement-level ranking offers an alternative by selecting concise, review-derived explanations, enabling fine-grained and reproducible evaluation using established ranking metrics. However, existing statement ranking methods largely rely on collaborative representations, while semantic enhancements often fail to outperform simple user-history popularity baselines. Moreover, directly adapting language models for personalized statement ranking remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce LMStaR (Language Models for Statement Ranking), a fully text-based framework that formulates personalized explanation ranking as dense retrieval. A query encoder represents the user's interaction history and target-item metadata, while a statement encoder maps candidate explanations into a shared embedding space. Both encoders are jointly adapted through multi-positive contrastive learning to learn personalized relevance. Experiments on Amazon Beauty, Amazon Toys, and Yelp show that LMStaR achieves the highest NDCG@1 across all three domains, outperforming CLER by 1.06--8.25 points (+11.8--65.9%). It also leads top-five ranking on both Amazon datasets, although CLER remains stronger on Yelp. Task-specific adaptation improves all five evaluated backbones and transfers across domains without target-domain fine-tuning. Counterfactual analyses further reveal the importance of user-specific histories. These findings highlight the potential of task-adapted language models for personalized explanation ranking.
papers.summary: 给用户挑推荐理由时，以往的方法常常连一个简单基线都赢不了，这个基线只看用户历史里哪些说法出现得最多。任务是从这件商品的所有评论里抽出、合并好一批简短说法，挑出最能打动这个用户的几条。LMStaR 用微调的文本 embedding 模型把它当成检索：一个编码器读入用户以前的评论和这件商品的信息，另一个编码器读入每条说法。训练时两者一起微调，让用户对这件商品真正写下的评论里的说法排到前面。在亚马逊美妆、玩具和 Yelp 上，它排第一位的理由都最准，比此前最强的方法 CLER 高 1.06 到 8.25 个点。

papers.title: DualEvolve: Dual-Level Self-Evolution of Mechanism and Orchestration for Recommendation
papers.authors: Tianqi Gao, Chenxu Wang, Wenxuan Yang, Yueqi Mou, Biao Tang, Ming Liu, Peng Yan
papers.abstract: Recommender systems are widely used in e-commerce and content platforms, where improvement requires repeated model design, training optimization, and experimental validation. Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate this development cycle. Sustained autonomous improvement requires agents to improve both recommendation models and their development workflows. However, task-performance-driven approaches select updates mainly by candidates' final scores, without a separate optimization signal for experimentation quality. We therefore present DualEvolve, a dual-level framework that co-evolves recommendation mechanisms and agent orchestration toward recursive self-improvement. Inner evolution revises model and training code using task feedback to improve recommendation performance. Outer evolution scores the inner-loop experimental process, updates harness and skill rules using these scores and execution traces, and adjusts orchestration choices based on next-round scores to improve the quality of subsequent experiments. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and three Amazon Reviews 2023 subsets cover four recommendation methods and 16 settings. DualEvolve achieves higher test means than Base, OpenEvolve, and DeepEvolve in all 64 setting-metric comparisons, with macro-averaged relative gains over DeepEvolve of 7.6% (HR@5) and 9.0% (NDCG@5).
papers.summary: 让 agent 自动改进推荐模型时，现有框架通常只看每个版本最后的分数，实验本身做得好不好没人打分。DualEvolve 给实验过程也打分，效果超过了只看分数的框架。它有两层循环。内层照常改模型和训练代码。外层让一个固定的大模型读这一轮的实验记录，按清单打分，比如改动有没有明确假设、有没有可比的对照、有没有把无效改动和程序出错分开；agent 再按分数修改自己遵循的规则，下一轮照新规则做实验。实验用四个数据集各配四种推荐模型，每种组合看四个推荐指标，在这全部 64 项比较里，它的测试效果都高于 OpenEvolve 和 DeepEvolve。

papers.title: DualClusterNet: Personalized Pattern-Space Composition for Next-POI Recommendation
papers.authors: Ziyang Su, Guanjie Zheng, Jilin Hu, Linghe Kong
papers.abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation supports personalized place discovery on location-based Web platforms. Mobility routines can recur across users while being realized at different places and adapted to individual preferences. We present DualClusterNet, a causal sequential recommender that composes two population-shared prototype dictionaries. At each observed prefix, soft routers retrieve pattern and spatial mixtures; a factorized multiplicative interaction couples them, feature-wise affine modulation adapts the shared representation, and a separate user-conditioned branch with an additive--projective gate retains individual variation. The prediction head combines this representation with a learned first-order transition term and ranks the complete training POI vocabulary. We evaluate on NYC and TKY using a training-only vocabulary and an original-final-target protocol that neither bridges unknown POIs nor substitutes earlier targets. The available single-seed results show competitive full-candidate ranking, while controlled analyses support the contribution of the compositional and personalized branches. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DualClusterNet-F4EE/.
papers.summary: 不同用户的出行规律常常相似，只是落在不同的地点上。DualClusterNet 做下一个地点推荐时把规律和地点分开学。模型里有两组所有用户共用、可以反复组合的向量，一组用来刻画签到的先后规律，一组用来刻画地理空间。模型把用户到目前为止的签到序列编码成一个向量，用它给两组里的每个向量打权重，各自加权求和，再把得到的规律向量和空间向量逐元素相乘，作为当下的出行偏好；另有一个只看该用户的分支保留个人差异。在纽约和东京两个签到数据集上，它排第一位的预测命中率最高，但领先很小，看前几位时别的方法更好，而且只跑了一个随机种子。

papers.title: Dataset Recommendation for Heterogeneous and Dynamic Scholarly Graphs via Multimodal Representation Learning
papers.authors: Ornella Irrera, Matteo Lissandrini, Daniele Dell'Aglio, Gianmaria Silvello
papers.abstract: Researchers struggle to find relevant datasets amid the growing volume of data across repositories and scholarly publications. Manual dataset retrieval is time-consuming and often fails to identify valuable resources that are not easily discoverable through direct links or popularity metrics. Dataset recommendation, which aims to identify datasets relevant to a paper, author, or query, has become essential for improving dataset discoverability and reuse. However, this task remains challenging because Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) are large-scale, heterogeneous, dynamic, and incomplete. Although openly available SKGs organize scientific knowledge by linking scholarly outcomes, they often lack meaningful connections between datasets, leaving them isolated and underutilized. These graphs contain millions of evolving relations but still suffer from missing or inaccurate metadata, duplicate records, and weak dataset integration. This work presents the Multimodal Scholarly Attention Network (MM-SAN), a heterogeneous multimodal graph representation learning method for recommending datasets relevant to research publications within real-world SKGs. MM-SAN combines topology-aware and text-based embeddings, enabling effective recommendations even when textual metadata is limited or absent. It operates in transductive, semi-inductive, and fully inductive settings, adapting to evolving SKGs without requiring retraining. Experiments show that MM-SAN outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing a robust and scalable solution for dataset recommendation.
papers.summary: 研究者找数据集很难，因为学术知识图谱里的数据集往往和论文、作者连得很少，不少还缺文字描述。MM-SAN 给论文推荐相关数据集。它先从论文和数据集的文字描述里识别出能对上知识库条目的实体，再用主题模型归出主题，把实体和主题作为新节点加进图里，提到同一实体或同一主题的论文和数据集就连上了。论文和数据集的表示同时来自图结构和文字描述，文字缺失时靠图结构补上。在测试节点都没训练过、只有 25% 的节点有文字描述的最难设置里，它的召回率比最强的图方法高 41%。
